concepts.title: Swamp — painted tabletop
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one NEW standalone landscape 3:2 concept image for Dice and Destiny's SWAMP exploration map. The reference is for visual style only. A readable elevated three-quarter isometric view of a small connected board made from six thick interlocking JIGSAW PUZZLE terrain pieces with obvious rounded knobs and complementary sockets on a cardinal square grid. Thin seams are clearly visible; pieces fit perfectly and are joined at the same height. The swamp is sculpted/illustrated on their surfaces: shallow murky water, muddy islands, cypress roots, drooping willow branches, reeds, lily pads, rotting wooden walkways and half-sunken mossy stones. Paths cross tile joins at north/south/east/west midpoints.
Specific scene: central wooden walkway crossroads with a single original cloaked lantern-bearing adventurer MINIATURE standing on its own clearly visible black circular beveled wargaming base on top of the central puzzle piece. One north branch leads to a half-drowned stone shrine; a west branch to a large twisted willow and fallen log bridge; a southern branch to a tiny stilted marsh hut with an amber window; east has a small landing with a moored rowboat and merchant bundles. Dense swamp details frame open readable paths. This must look unmistakably like a swamp, not a dungeon or mountain biome.
One additional matching jigsaw tile bearing a marsh trail and cypress roots is falling vertically a short distance above an EMPTY eastern destination cell. Clear matching tab/socket silhouette, a landing shadow, a few falling droplets and a restrained warm light tracing the joining edge. Most of the board is already connected and remains still. Make the miniature much smaller than a tile, an exploration pawn rather than a life-size person.
Keep the entire board, its round-based character and incoming tile visible inside the image with comfortable margins. No text, no UI, no health bars, no cards, no dice, no collage, no multiple panels, no watermark. Terrain identities and little landmarks should be readable without obscuring jigsaw contours.
Style reference role: supplied magical tabletop map establishes the first batch's richly detailed sculptural miniature art treatment and dramatic lighting. Create a NEW SWAMP terrain map, do not copy its cave, crystal formations or mushrooms. Premium hand-painted fantasy diorama game art; tactile moss, carved stone, sculpted roots, gently reflective resin-like swamp water, miniature brushwork, warm lanterns contrasted against moody blue-green fog. Palette: lush moss and olive greens, deep teal stagnant water, warm brown wood, soft blue-gray mist, muted amber light, tiny fireflies. Beautiful atmospheric fantasy, slightly ominous yet inviting to explore. Dark softly blurred tabletop backdrop. Crisp 3D terrain relief and rich natural textures, matching the first batch's miniature-world look.

Style reference role: the supplied battle-screen image is ONLY a reference for the current game's hand-illustrated dark fantasy ink-and-watercolor style and color choices. Do not copy its battle layout, wasteland, creatures or interface. Transform the NEW SWAMP scene into a somber ink and watercolor illustration with stained parchment texture, granular gray washes, fine scratchy penwork, rough brush edges and deep charcoal shadows. Bone-white dead bark, muddy desaturated olive water, ash-gray planks, soot-black roots, aged ivory cloth, a trace of dried burgundy fabric, isolated warm lantern light. Mature eerie dark fantasy, lonely and weathered. Sparse leaves, sagging moss, black water and pallid reeds. Backdrop is near-black watercolor bleeding into dirty parchment at the corners. Selectively dimensional puzzle pieces but genuinely painterly surfaces and architectural linework; no glossy CGI, vibrant emerald, cyan neon, purple crystals, cute toys or saturated colors. Keep the anatomy of the miniature, visible circular base, and puzzle joins crisp enough to read.
